purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Emergency Monetary Policy
question: Under which U.S. federal authorities may private payment and digital-asset rails be contracted, pre-positioned, controlled or protected?
bluf: The U.S. legal activation map separates ordinary authorization, emergency procurement, DPA and Stafford activation, financial facilities, IEEPA controls and stablecoin emergency or national-security seams. Availability and legal authority do not themselves establish incident-specific activation or operation.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a material with public_full_text true, prefer reading_url; failure to retrieve it is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the evidence cutoff. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
